knowledgeAnswers.rationale: The window customer buys a clean result with certainty that a missed pane will be fixed. The hourly rate and the ladder list are inputs, not the outcome.
A guarantee must be something you can deliver and afford, or it damages the business. The return-visit promise must be one you can keep.
A claim about the result must be substantiated by evidence that supports it. The lesson says not to promise results that you cannot show.

practicalCriteria: Applies the step to a real or simulated business decision and records the outcome
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
evidenceRequired: Written output of the step (plan, offer, log or record)
stopWorkCriteria: Not applicable: business guidance; stop if an offer would make an unsubstantiated or misleading claim
